content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no post-termination transition assistance, data return or deletion provision. Section 14 (Termination) addresses only the run-off of Hosting and Support Services to month-end; Section 13 goes the other way and places the burden squarely on Client to arrange a new name server within 30 days and a new hosting environment within 60 days, with no obligation on TrueLink to assist or to hand back data. Section 10 (Confidentiality) imposes confidentiality obligations on TrueLink as to Client Proprietary Information but contains no return-or-destroy mechanic, and Section 2(f) (Backups) confirms TrueLink holds Client data files without any exit obligation. Searches for \"termination\", \"return\" and \"data\" surface no export, migration or certified-deletion language anywhere in the document, so neither the preferred nor the fallback position is met. Given that TrueLink hosts the Web Site and holds Credit Data (borrower and loan data), absence of an exit clause is a material gap for a hosting agreement. Inserted the preferred formulation into Section 14: six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter, with a carve-out for retention required by law or by the System/Credit Repository Agreements referenced in Sections 1 and 13. The 90-day fallback is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance, data return and certified deletion obligations into Section 14 (Termination)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 14 ends the Hosting and Support Services but says nothing about getting our data back or help migrating, and Section 13 puts the whole burden of finding a new hosting environment on us. We have added our standard exit provision: up to six months of transition assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can accept ninety days of assistance provided the thirty-day data return and deletion certificate remain.

ops.text: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Client's request, return to Client all Client Content, Credit Data and other Client data and Client Proprietary Information then in TrueLink's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data and information from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing, except to the extent retention is required by applicable law or by any System Agreement or Credit Repository Agreement.
